reference.shortdesc: Consider a markdown file that has a bulleted list to describe the key benefits of

section.p: Consider a markdown file that has a bulleted list to describe the key benefits of a monitoring system.

entry.codeblock: # Monitoring Benefits The monitoring system provides the following benefits: - Real-time alerting - Automated escalation - Historical trend analysis - Centralized event management

Monitoring Benefits

The monitoring system provides the following benefits:

  • Real-time alerting
  • Automated escalation
  • Historical trend analysis
  • Centralized event management

section.p: Result: The converter recognizes the consecutive bullet items as an unordered list and generates a DITA <ul> element. Each bullet item becomes a DITA <li> element.
